# New York Daily News

> > A comprehensive digital news platform covering New York City breaking news, sports, crime, politics, and local events with deep community coverage.

The New York Daily News is a major metropolitan news outlet providing extensive coverage of New York City, Brooklyn, and surrounding areas. The site aggregates local news, sports coverage of major NY teams (Yankees, Mets, Giants, Nets), crime and public safety reporting, and community-focused journalism.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- New York City
- Crime & Public Safety
- NYPD
- Local News
- Sports Coverage
- Brooklyn
- Politics & Elections
- Business News
- Community News
- Daily Headlines
- NYC Metro
- Police Incidents
- Staten Island
- New York Teams

## News & Breaking Coverage

- [News – New York Daily News](https://www.nydailynews.com/news): Main news section with breaking news, politics, business and crime coverage
- [Crime & Public Safety](https://www.nydailynews.com/news/crime-public-safety): Crime and public safety news coverage for New York City and Brooklyn

## Sports

- [Sports News – New York Daily News](https://www.nydailynews.com/sports): Sports news and coverage of NY Yankees, Mets, Giants, Nets and local teams

## Homepage

- [New York Daily News: New York News, Sports, Weather, Business & Things to Do](https://www.nydailynews.com): Homepage featuring NY news, sports, weather, business and local events

## Optional

- [Cookie Management Utility](https://www.nydailynews.com/util-clean-cookies): Cookie management utility and subscription prompt redirect page
